statement.zh: 迈杜姆 1890–91 年金字塔、神庙与马斯塔巴发掘见 Petrie《迈杜姆》（1892）。
statement.en: At Meidum, the 1890–91 excavations of the pyramid, temple, and mastabas are documented in Petrie Medum (1892).
